spans.s:
(शि) r. 6th cl. (कुटति)
1 To make crooked.
2 To be or become crooked.
3 To be dishonest, to cheat or deceive.
(इ) कुटि (कुण्टति)
1 To be stopped or obstructed, to be prevented from moving.
2 To confound or disorder from pain or grief: see कुडि
r. 10th cl. (कुटयते कोटयति)
1 To cut: see त्रुट.
2 To heat: see कुट्ट.

mn. (-टः-टं)
1 A water pot.
mf. (-टः-टी)
A house; also कुटि.
m. (-टः)
1 A fort, a strong hold.
2 A tree: see कुठ.
6 A hammer, a mallet for breaking small stones.
4 A mountain.
f. (-टी)
1 A kind of perfume, commonly

Mura.
2

A bawd, a procuress or go-between.
3 A nosegay, a bundle or tuft of flowers or vegetables.
E.
कुठ to go crookedly, &c. कः aff.

r. 10th cl. (कुट्टयति)
1 To cut, to divide.
2 To grind or pound.
3 To censure.
1st cl. (कुट्टति) 10th cl. (कुट्टयति)
To heat, some make this root कुट.

r. 10th cl. (कूटयते)
1 To avoid or decline giving, to not give.
2 To render indistinct or unintelligible, to muddle or render confused or foul.
(कूटयति)
1 To give pain.
2 To burn.
3 To call or invite, to counsel or advise.

mf. (-टः-टी)
A house, a dwelling: see कुट.
mn. (-टः-टं)
1 The peak or summit of a mountain.
2 A water-jar.
3 A heap of grain, &c.
4 Uniform and elementary substance.
5 A hammer, a mallet.
6 A ploughshare.
7 The body of a plough.
8 A trap for catching deer.
9 A concealed weapon, as a dagger in a wooden case, a sword-cane, &c.
10

Illusion.
11

Fraud, trick, deceit.
12 Untruth, falsehood, (or attributively,) false, untrue.
13 Vile, low.
14 An ox whose horns are broken.
m. (-टः)
The name of a saint, also named AGASTYA.
E.
कूट to confuse, to withhold, अच् aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A roof, a thatch.
E.
कुट a house, in the third case, and क what makes.

m. (-कः)
1 An arbour formed by creeping plants overrunning a tree.
2 A roof or thatch.
3 A house, a small house, a hut or cottage: see कुटुङ्गक.

m. (-चः)
Coraya: see the next.

m. (-जः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Coraya, (Echites antidysenterica, Rox.) the seeds are used as a vermifuge: see इन्द्रयव.
2 A name of the saint

AGASTYA.
3

Also of DROṆA a sage and warrior: see द्रोण.
E.
कूट a mountain peak, and ज what is produced; the vowel of कूट being made short.

m. (-जः)
A medicinal plant: see कुटज.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant grass: see मुस्त.

m. (-टः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
n. (-टं)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
कुटन् being crooked, नट to dance or wave, and अच् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 A saint, a divine sage or

Muni.
2

A garden or grove near a house.
3 A measure of grain, &c. see कुडप.
(-पं)
A lotus.
E.
कुट a house, and प what nourishes.

m. (-रः)
A post round which the string passes that works the churning stick: see कुठर.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
n. (-रं)
1

Pleasure.
2

A blanket.
adv.
Only, merely. (केवले) This word is also written कुट्टीर and कुठार, but perhaps inaccurately.

n. (-रु)
A tent, a house of cloth or canvas.
E.
कुट to be crooked, अरु Uṇādi aff.

f. (-णा)
A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.)

n. (-लं)
A roof, a thatch: see कुटङ्क.

f. (-का)
A female slave or servant.
E.
कुट a water pot, and हारिका who carries.

mf. (-टिः-टिः or -टी)
A house.
m. (-टिः)
1 A tree.
2 The body.
3 Curvature, a curve.
E.
कुट to be crooked, इ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
A porpoise.
E.
कुटि a curve, चर who goes.

m. (-रः)
An ascetic of a particular order, one who consigns the care of his family to his son, and remains at home engaged solely in devotion.
E.
कुटी a house, and चर who goes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Crooked, bent.
E.
कुट to be curved, इतः Uṇādi affix; also कुटिल.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
1 Being bent.
2 Acting dishonestly.
E.
कुट to be crooked, तृच् aff.

n. (-रं)
A hut, a cottage.
E.
कुटि a house, रा to be like, ड aff.

m. (-रः)
A small house, a hut, a hovel.
E.
कुटी a house, and र aff.

m. (-रः)
A mountain: see कुट्टार.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Crooked, bent.
2 Dishonest, fraudulent.
n. (-लं)
Tin.
f. (-ला)
The name of a river, the Kuṭilā river, according to some, a name of the SARASVATĪ.
E.
कुट to be crooked, किलच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Tortuous, going crookedly.
E.
कुटिल, and गामिन् what goes.

Crookedness.
2

Guile, dishonesty.
E.
कुटिल and तस्र् affix; also with त्व, कुटिलत्वं. n. (-त्वं)

f. (-का)
1 A blacksmith's forge.
2 Crouching, coming stealthily as a hunter on his prey.
E.
कुटिल, and इकन् aff.

m. (-कः)
One who lives at his son's expense.

m. (-कः)
1 An arbour or bower, formed of creeping plants.
2 A thatch, a roof.
3 A hut, a cottage.
4 A creeper winding round a tree.
E.
कुट to be crooked, क affix, कुट and अङ्ग the body, with कन् added; the form is irr.; also कुटङ्कक.

r. 10th cl. (कुटुम्बयते)
To support a family.

m. (-म्बः)
1 A name.
2 A kinsman, a relation by descent.
3 A connexion, a relation by the mother's side by marriage, &c.
4 Offspring, progeny.
5 Family, race.
E.
कुटुम्ब to support a family, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Being of one family.
n. (-कं)
A family, a kindred.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-तः)
A provident and attentive father of a family.
E.
कुटुम्ब kindred, and व्यापृत one who manages.

f. (-ता)
Family connexion or union, living as one family.
E.
कुटुम्बिन्, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कुटिम्बित्व.

mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि)
1 A peasant, a cultivator of the soil.
2 One who supports or has a family.
m. (-म्बी)
A householder, a pater-familias.
f. (-म्बिनी)
1 The wife of a householder and mother of a family, a matron.
2 A small shrub used in medicine, a kind of moon plant: see क्षीरिणी.
E.
कुटुम्ब kindred, &c. and इनि poss. aff.

n. adj. (-र्थं)
For the support or on account of a family.
E.
कुटुम्ब, and अर्थ object.

n. (-कः)
Apartments, &c. appropriated to the accommodation of relations, &c.
E.
कुटुम्ब kindred, and ओकस् a house.

m. (-रः)
A hut, a cottage.
E.
कुट to be crooked, एरक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What cuts.
2 What pounds or grinds.
m. (-कः)
1 A power in arithmetic or algebra, a quantity such, [] that a given number being multiplied by it, and the product added to a given quantity, the sum may be divisible without remainder by a given divisor.
2 A kingfisher.
E.
कुट्ट to pound, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
What cuts or divides.
E.
कुट्ट to cut, षाकन aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unfair, fraudulent.
n. (-कं)
A ploughshare.
m. (-कः)
1 A braid or tress of hair.
2 A perfume: see मुरा.
E.
कूट to cut, and क्वुन् aff.

m. (-रः)
That branch of arithmetic which treats of the Kuṭṭaka: see the last.
E.
कुट्टक, and व्यवहार practice; also कुट्टकाध्याय or chapter.

n. (-नं)
1 Pounding, grinding, cutting, dividing.
2 Abusing.
f. (-नी)
A bawd, a procuress, a go-between.
E.
कुट्ट to cut, ल्युट् and ङीष् affs.

n. (-तं)
One of the ten graces of women, affected repulse of a lover's caresses.

mfn. (-ट्टी-ट्टिनी-टि)
What cuts or pounds.
f. (-नी)
A bawd, a procures.
E.
कुट्ट cutting, इनि aff.

mn. (-मः-मं)
1 A jewel mine.
2 Ground smoothed and plastered.
3 Ground prepared for the site of a mansion.
4 A hut, a cottage.
5 The pomegranate.
E.
कुट्ट to cut or pierce, and इमच् aff.

f. (-का)
A female servant, a slave: see कुटहारिका.

mn. (-लः-लं)
An opening bud.
n. (-लं)
One of the hells in which sinners are punished, where they are bound with ropes.
E.
कुट to be curved, and क्मलच् Uṇādi affix, or कल affix, with मुट् inserted.

m. (-रः)
1 A rogue.
2 A cheat, a false witness.
E.
कूट, and कार who makes.

m. (-कः)
1 A false witness.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
E.
कूट, and कारक who makes.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Fraudulent, dishonest.
m. (-कृत्)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A Kāyastha or man of the writer cast.
E.
कूट illusion, &c. and कृत् who makes.

f. (-ता)
Falsehood, fraud.
E.
तल् added to कूट; also with त्व, कूटत्वं.

m. (-र्व्वः)
Fever occurring in an elephant from vitiation of the three humors; also read कूटपूर्व्व.

m. (-लः)
1 A bilious fever in an elephant.
2 A potter's kiln.
E.
कूट a heap, and पाक what ripens, लच् aff.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A trap or snare for deer, birds, &c.
E.
कूट a trap, and यन्त्र an implement; also simply कूट.

m. (-लिः)
A species of the Simul silk cotton tree.
E.
कूट false, and शाल्मलि the Simul.

n. (-नं)
A forged or false grant or decree.
E.
कूट, and शासन a grant, &c.

m. (-क्षी)
A false witness.
E.
कूट falsehood, and साक्षिन् a witness.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Uniform, perpetually and universally the same, as spirit, elementary matter, aether, &c.
n. (-स्थं)
1 The soul.
2 A sort of perfume, a species of dried shell fish, commonly Nakhi.
E.
कूट fixed, and स्थ what remains.

n. (-र्णं)
Alloyed or counterfeit gold. कूट, and स्वर्ण gold.

m. (-क्षः)
Loaded or false dice.
E.
कूट, and अक्ष a die.

n. (-रं)
An upper room, an apartment on the top of a house.
E.
कूट a peak, आगार a house.

f. (-ता)
A tale, a story, a fiction.
E.
कूट false, अर्थ meaning, and भाषिता spoken.
